view.name: Game result chain
view.description: Result chain of a past game showing the first word, each player's drawing and the guesses that followed.

regions.label: 'Results #1' title with presenter instruction and divider
Vertical chain of alternating guessed words (large h1) and drawings (452px square bordered images)
Grey well summarizing start word vs end word
'View more results' vertical button group 1–6 (current disabled), Done and Exit Archive buttons
Credit line with author and GitHub links

evidence.note: Numbered results 1–6 as vertical button group; current (1. minion) disabled; clicking 2 replaces the chain in place with 'Results #2' (verified live), URL unchanged

patterns.rationale: Could equally be read as vertical tabs switching peer result chains; no next/prev, just numbered direct-jump buttons.

evidence.note: Peer result views switched in the same space by labelled buttons; current shown disabled

patterns.rationale: Behaves like peer-view switching, but rendered as a numbered button list below the content, more like pagination.

evidence.quote: You started with: minion and ended up with: hot dog
evidence.note: Bootstrap 'well' grey filled container with thin border summarizing the chain

patterns.rationale: It is a bounded summary container, but a single well rather than an item card in a collection.

evidence.note: Result chain is sequential game content, not an event log
Drawings are static images in archive view, no drawing tools

structure.layout: single narrow centered column (~452px) of stacked headings and square drawings, ending with a numbered results switcher, buttons and footer

aesthetics.typography: Pangolin (handwritten-style rounded sans) used for everything: headings, words, buttons, footer
aesthetics.typeScale: Guessed words h1 40px/500, title h2 32px, labels h4 24px, buttons 20px, body/footer 16px; modest weight contrast, hierarchy via size

notes: Bootstrap 3-era layout with Pangolin handwritten font giving a playful party-game feel. Content is a 'telephone' chain: word → player drawing (452×452 thin-bordered square, user crayon-like strokes) → guess → drawing → guess, then a grey well comparing start and end words. Result switcher is a vertical stacked btn-group-vertical of numbered words, the current one disabled/greyed. Almost no colour besides user drawings and blue footer links.
